summary: Formats a time gap between the race-state object behind dword_7C54E0 and a target object into a string written to the caller's a1 buffer. Copies a leading prefix into a1 first, then reads the target pointer from dword_7C54E0 + 16596. When the target is valid and LapTimeGapCalculation succeeds, a gap value v7 drives two formatting branches: v7 <= 0 renders a "+MM:SS.FFF" time string (via fabs + SpatialGridCell into the same buffer), otherwise v7 renders as " +N %s" where the pluralizer is chosen by off_5CCE74 vs aLaps_0 and is normalized through the string table in byte_5EC4CC. All paths return 0.

local_names.a1: destination character buffer that also carries the float gap into the gap-calculation and formatting helpers
local_names.a2: unused second parameter of the raw prototype
local_names.v2: buffer pointer returned by the initial strcpy of the prefix string
local_names.v3: target object pointer read from dword_7C54E0 + 16596
local_names.v4: gap component from the calculation (lap count on the lap branch, seconds component on the time branch)
local_names.v5: pluralizer string selected between off_5CCE74 and aLaps_0
local_names.v7: gap value produced by LapTimeGapCalculation; its sign selects the time-format vs lap-format branch

operations.description: Copy the leading prefix string asc_5CCE54 into the destination buffer a1 via strcpy and keep the buffer pointer in v2
If the dword at dword_7C54E0 + 16484 is non-zero, return 0 immediately (suppression/debug flag blocks formatting)
v3 = *(dword_7C54E0 + 16596) reads the target object pointer that the gap is measured against
Return 0 when the target pointer v3 is null, when *(v3 + 16484) is non-zero, or when LapTimeGapCalculation(dword_7C54E0, v3, (float*)&a1, &v7) reports failure
v4 = v7 captures the gap value for the later lap-count formatting branch
Branch on v7 <= 0: the time-gap formatting path; otherwise the lap-count formatting path
Time path: take the absolute value of the float gap in the a1 buffer, then SpatialGridCell splits it into minutes/seconds components stored back into v7 and the a1 float buffer
Time path: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v2, "+%.2d:%06.3f", v7, *(float*)&a1) renders the "+MM:SS.FFF" gap string into the destination buffer
Lap path: v5 = off_5CCE74 as the default pluralizer string, replaced by aLaps_0 when v7 != 1

Lap path: BinarySearchInStringTable(byte_5EC4C0, v5, byte_5EC4CC) looks the pluralizer up in the sorted string table; on a match v5 is copied into byte_5EC4CC, or byte_5EC4CC is cleared when v5 is null
Lap path: StringFormatWithBufferOverflowCheck(v2, " +%d %s", v4, byte_5EC4CC) renders the " +N laps" gap string into the destination buffer
Reached from sub_49D700 and DrawDebugTextOverlay as a HUD/overlay gap-string helper
